title: InSituGame: In Situ Spatial Evolutionary Game Assay for Inferring Tumor Subclonal Payoff Matrices and Guiding Adaptive Therapy
description: Computational and evolutionary game theory assay inferring subclonal payoff matrices in situ directly from spatial transcriptomics data to guide evolutionary-enlightened adaptive therapy in solid tumors.

creators.name: Celebrano, Luca
creators.affiliation: Department of Clinical Medicine and Surgery, School of Medicine, University of Naples Federico II, Naples, Italy
